## Summary

Describe the user-visible and scientific effect of the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] `npm run checksums:write` was run after the final change.
- [ ] No confidential or identifiable research data were added.
- [ ] Calculation changes include an independent synthetic oracle or regression case.
- [ ] User-facing rules and documentation were updated when applicable.

## Scientific compatibility

State whether the change affects pairing, effect size, Wilcoxon testing, FDR, assessment labels, Tier scoring or DOCX output.
